title: Mnemosyne explicit project knowledge substrate
goal: Establish project-local capture, classification, review, deterministic search, maintenance and reconstructible export without opaque memory authority.

work.problem: OTHRYS exposes knowledge files but lacks a durable knowledge service and lifecycle comparable to Panda Atlas.
out_of_scope: No automatic promotion to canonical truth
No knowledge write API in Command Deck
risks: Research is mistaken for canonical truth

laws: Explicit files and records are the source of truth.
Search is deterministic and local in this mission.
Maintenance reports issues but performs zero mutation.
Export must be reconstructible and content-digest bound.

tasks.title: Bind declared sources to explicit content digests
Implement inbox capture and non-promoting review
Implement deterministic search, maintenance and export
Verify path scope, authority-free lifecycle and reconstructibility

slices.title: Panda Atlas quarry captured through Mnemosyne

tasks.title: Capture Panda Atlas service-boundary finding into inbox
Verify reviewed Panda finding remains non-canonical
Verify Command Deck has no knowledge write route
